reasoning: On the season so far the Hawks are the stronger team; with home court the Hawks start about 6 points better, in a game of about 246 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Hawks win 67 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 221 and 270 total points.

analyst.text: Chicago have lost eight straight, are winless at home, and blew a 22-point lead to San Antonio on Wednesday. No. 4 pick Caleb Wilson fractured his right hand and faces surgery and about four to six weeks out, and Norman Powell is questionable with back spasms. Atlanta had three days to reset after the Lakers ended their four-game win streak, and this NBA Cup game opens a road trip. The mental lean is toward Atlanta; a Bulls team that keeps blowing leads is fragile late in games.
